about: The open world's plan: a video-game compression of the San Mateo coast and peninsula. Written by hand by the owner and Claude; measured over the real ground by `cargo run -p mp_atlas -- report`, drawn by tools/atlas.html. Coordinates are [lat, lon], as Google Maps copies them. docs/vision/atlas.md explains every field.

places.name: San Gregorio: Highway 84 meets Highway 1
places.note: Almost at sea level, at the mouth of San Gregorio Creek.

places.name: The crest above San Gregorio
places.note: Highway 1 climbs a little north of the junction to a crest with a beautiful view up the coast. The first race starts here, in the dark. Placed at the first crest mp-atlas finds along Highway 1 north of the junction: 2.1 km on and 125 m up, at about 145 m.

places.name: Half Moon Bay: Highway 1 at Highway 92
places.note: The big intersection. The first race finishes here; the world's origin.

places.name: Skylonda: Highway 35 meets Highway 84
places.note: Alice's Restaurant: motorbikes, sports cars, Sunday mornings. A car meet.

places.name: Kings Mountain: Skyline at Tunitas Creek Road
The pumpkin patches on 92
places.note: Farm stands, pumpkins, the Art and Pumpkin Festival in October; nurseries and greenhouses.

places.name: Devil's Slide: the tunnels' south portal
places.note: The old cliff road round the slide is a trail now; the game can open it again.

places.name: Crystal Springs: Skyline above the reservoir
The salt ponds
places.note: Flat crystallizer beds by the bay: the desert's dry lake bed, under the moon.

places.name: El Corte de Madera: the fire roads
places.note: Dirt roads in the redwoods off Skyline: a rallycross loop.

places.name: Montara Mountain: the trailhead
places.note: Steep, rocky fire roads above Montara and Pacifica: crawler hills.

regions.name: The South Coast
regions.character: Highway 1 on the bluffs from San Gregorio to Half Moon Bay: farms to the cliff edge, yellow mustard in the cover crops, wildflowers, Brussels sprouts and artichokes, pumpkins in October, the creeks' beaches below, fog in the mornings.
regions.real: Highway 1 from San Gregorio to Half Moon Bay

regions.name: Half Moon Bay
regions.character: The real town at its real size: Main Street, the big intersection, the beaches, El Granada, the harbour at Princeton and Pillar Point, Mavericks offshore. The home base: a garage, a gas station, the start of jobs.
regions.real: Half Moon Bay, El Granada, Princeton

regions.name: The Midcoast and Devil's Slide
regions.character: Moss Beach and Montara, the old cliff road at Devil's Slide and the new tunnels, down into Pacifica's surf town. The drive home.

regions.name: Montara Mountain
regions.character: Steep, rocky hills between the coast and the reservoir: fire roads and trails graded by difficulty, a crawler parked at the trailhead.
regions.real: Montara Mountain, McNee Ranch, Sweeney Ridge

regions.name: Over the hill: Highway 92
regions.character: Out of town past the pumpkin patches, nurseries and greenhouses, then the climb: the switchbacks of 92 up the ridge with the bay's lights and the coast behind.
regions.real: Highway 92 from Half Moon Bay to Skyline

regions.name: Skyline
regions.character: The ridge road in fog so dense the redwoods drip with it, so it feels like rain; then out above the fog, both the ocean and the bay below. Alice's at Skylonda.
regions.real: Highway 35 from 92 to Skylonda, Kings Mountain

regions.name: The state parks
regions.character: Purisima Creek, El Corte de Madera, Tunitas Creek: dirt roads and clearings in the redwoods between the coast and the ridge. Rallycross, and the secret dirt shortcut.
regions.real: Purisima Creek Redwoods, El Corte de Madera Creek, Tunitas Creek

regions.name: The redwoods: 84 and La Honda
regions.character: A twisty descent through redwood forest from Skylonda, through La Honda, down San Gregorio Creek to the coast and the general store.
regions.real: Highway 84, with the character of Highway 9

regions.name: Crystal Springs and 280
regions.character: Down the far side of the ridge to the reservoir in its long valley, and 280 running beside it: the world's most beautiful freeway, north to the city.
regions.real: Crystal Springs Reservoir, Cañada Road, Interstate 280

regions.name: The Bayside
regions.character: The peninsula's towns become one city along the bay: El Camino Real, Caltrain, 101 by the water, the salt ponds and the airport. Night freeways and the train.
regions.real: Redwood City to South San Francisco

regions.name: The City
regions.character: The big city at the top of the peninsula: hills to jump at the crossings, the grid, the towers, the Great Highway along the ocean.

routes.name: Highway 1: San Gregorio to Half Moon Bay
Highway 1: Half Moon Bay to Pacifica
Tunitas Creek Road: the redwood climb
routes.note: One lane in places, steep, under redwoods all the way: the Highway 9 character the owner wants, inside the loop.

routes.name: Stage Road: San Gregorio to Pescadero

circuits.name: The loop: 1, 92, Skyline and 84
circuits.note: The first piece of open world: closed, so you can drive it round and round.

events.name: Midnight on the Coast
events.light: night: the moon on the sea, the farms dark, the town's lights ahead
events.note: The game's first race. Start at the crest with the view, race through the farmland, finish at the big intersection in Half Moon Bay.

events.name: Over the Hill
events.note: Past the pumpkin patches, then up the switchbacks.

remix.now: Cliff road before dawn, Seabright's beach boulevard at sunrise, the harbour bridge into Port Meridian.
remix.becomes: The South Coast and Half Moon Bay: its cliff road is the bluffs north of San Gregorio, Seabright's boulevard is Half Moon Bay's beaches and Main Street, the harbour is Pillar Point. The level stays as it is until the remix is chosen.

remix.now: Switchbacks up Sierra Pass, the old farms of Mill Valley, the Interstate into Meridian, sunset to midnight.
remix.becomes: Highway 92 and Skyline: the pass's switchbacks become 92's climb and the Kings Mountain grades, Mill Valley's farms the pumpkin patches, the Interstate 280 by the reservoir. The real Sierra is a road trip.

remix.now: A red rock canyon at golden hour, a freight train down the old highway, a dry lake bed under the moon.
remix.becomes: Two pieces: the freight race becomes a race beside the railway on the bay side, and the dry lake bed becomes the salt ponds by the bay under the moon; the canyon's rocks become Montara Mountain's crawler hills. The real desert is a road trip.

remix.now: The grid of downtown Meridian: ninety-degree corners, jumps over the crossings of Nob Hill, the towers.
remix.becomes: San Francisco: it already is, nearly.

remix.now: An endless freeway loop through Meridian at midnight.
remix.becomes: 101 and 280 at night, joined at both ends into a loop up and down the peninsula.

remix.now: Three laps of a real circuit in the golden hills, rebuilt from lidar.
remix.becomes: Stays itself: a road trip south to the raceway, as Cruis'n World jumps.
